knowledge.genesis.primitive.awakening.de:
You are the last human on Earth. The cryo capsule has opened, the lab is long dead, only emergency lamps are on.

1. Step out of the capsule.
2. Go to the table on the right — this handbook lies on it.
3. RMB the handbook to take it.
4. Q opens the handbook.

Quests here give no rewards: they explain how the world works. Almost everything is made with your hands, not in windows: two hands (F swaps them), RMB with a pair of items — craft in hands, R — creation mode (shaping blocks by striking them).
knowledge.genesis.primitive.fiber.desc:
1. Gather grass: LMB tall grass with a bare hand.
2. Take one grass (or more) in the right and left hand — the left hand is a separate slot, F swaps hands.
3. Hold RMB.
4. You twist the grass.
5. Plant fiber appears in the hotbar, not in the left hand. Two grass make one fiber. It is made one at a time; keep holding RMB to continue while you have grass.
knowledge.genesis.primitive.rope.desc:
1. Take plant fiber in the right and left hand.
2. Hold RMB.
3. You braid a rope.
4. The rope appears in the hotbar. Two fibers make one rope.
knowledge.genesis.primitive.blade.desc:
1. Collect stones: pebbles lie on the ground (plenty near the lab exit), gravel drops 1–2 when hit by hand.
2. Take a pebble in the right and left hand.
3. Hold RMB — you knap a stone point.
4. The point appears in the hotbar. Two stones make one point.
knowledge.genesis.primitive.tool.desc:
There are no wooden or stone tools. You need a stick, a stone point and a rope. Sticks drop from leaves and dead bushes.

1. A stick in one hand, a rope in the other.
2. Hold RMB — you wrap the rope around the stick.
3. A wrapped handle appears in the left hand.
4. Take the stone point in the right hand.
5. Hold RMB — you fit the point and keep wrapping.
6. The chopper appears in the hotbar.

The chopper is universal: it digs, chops, crushes and fights, but slower than a dedicated tool. It wears out; repair it with a rope in the left hand and holding RMB.
knowledge.genesis.primitive.wood.desc:
1. Hold LMB on a tree with the chopper.
2. The whole tree falls and breaks into logs, leaves fall too (sometimes sticks).
3. Collect the logs and place one.
4. Aim at the log and press R — creation mode.
5. Strike with LMB: the log turns 90° after every strike, 4 strikes in total.
6. The log splits into 4 planks and you leave the mode.
knowledge.genesis.primitive.fence.desc:
Part of the workbench quest.

1. Place a plank.
2. Hold R — a selection wheel appears.
3. Move the mouse to "Fence" and release R.
4. 6 strikes — the plank turns on every side.
5. The plank splits into 3 fences.
knowledge.genesis.primitive.slab.desc:
Part of the workbench quest.

1. Place a plank.
2. Hold R and choose "Slab".
3. 2 strikes — 2 slabs.

The same wheel has "Sticks": 2 strikes — 4 sticks.
knowledge.genesis.primitive.workbench.de:
1. Place two fences side by side.
2. Put slabs on top of them.
3. Aim at the structure, press R.
4. Strike anywhere on it with a tool.
5. A 2×1 workbench appears instead.

A broken workbench drops whole — carry it and place it again. The workbench is a work surface: RMB with an item puts it on top, RMB with an empty hand takes it back. Items on it are worked in creation mode (R).
knowledge.genesis.primitive.fire.desc:
1. Place a plank on the ground.
2. Take a stick in the right hand.
3. Aim at the plank, press R.
4. Hold RMB — you spin the stick between your palms, smoke rises. Release and the progress slowly drops.
5. You get an ember. It lives about a minute — hurry.
knowledge.genesis.primitive.campfire.des:
1. A stick in each hand, hold RMB — kindling.
2. Place the kindling.
3. RMB the kindling with the ember — a campfire.

A campfire lights the night and keeps creatures away. A stick + an ember in your hands make two torches.
knowledge.genesis.primitive.furnace.desc:
1. Dig 8 cobblestone (chopper on stone).
2. Place blocks in a 3×3 checkerboard, two layers (layout below): cobblestone in a cross at the edges, any blocks (e.g. dirt) in the corners and the center.
3. Press R and strike with a tool.
4. The whole structure turns into one block — a furnace two blocks tall.

Carried like the workbench.
knowledge.genesis.primitive.charcoal.des:
1. Open the furnace (RMB with an empty hand).
2. Put logs into the input, fuel (planks, sticks) into the fuel slot.
3. Wait until it burns down.
4. Take the charcoal — the forge needs it.
knowledge.genesis.primitive.bed.desc:
1. A rope in the left hand, 4 grass in the right, hold RMB — a hay bundle.
2. Place 2 bundles side by side.
3. Press R and strike with a tool — a 2×1 bed.
4. RMB the bed at night — sleep, the night is skipped.
5. RMB in the daytime — your respawn point.

Too dark at night? Raise the brightness in the settings.
knowledge.genesis.primitive.bellows.desc:
Part of the forge quest.

1. Get a hide from an animal.
2. Put 2 planks and the hide on the workbench (RMB with the item).
3. Press R on the workbench, choose "Bellows", 4 strikes.
Part of the forge quest.

1. Place a cobblestone, press R.
2. 8 strikes with the chopper, the block turns after each.
3. You get a stone anvil. It will do until the iron one.
knowledge.genesis.primitive.coating.desc:
Part of the forge quest.

1. Dig some clay (near water).
2. RMB the furnace with clay 4 times — the coated furnace holds heat.
knowledge.genesis.primitive.forge.desc:
A forge is an upgraded furnace.

1. Place the bellows right next to the side of the coated furnace.
2. Press R and strike the structure with a tool — a forge.

Using the forge: open it, load ore and charcoal and pump the bellows — keep the heat needle in the green zone. Too cold — nothing happens, too hot — charcoal burns in vain.
knowledge.genesis.primitive.iron.desc:
1. Mine iron ore with the chopper (slowly).
2. Roast the ore in the forge — an iron bloom.
3. Put the bloom on an anvil, press R, 6 strikes — an iron ingot.

After that furnaces can smelt iron by themselves.
knowledge.genesis.primitive.iron_tools.d:
Shovel, axe, pickaxe, hoe.

1. Heat an ingot in the forge. A hot ingot cools down in about 20 seconds.
2. Put it on an anvil, hold R and choose a head: pickaxe — 6 strikes, axe — 5, shovel — 4, hoe — 3.
3. Cooled down too early — back to the forge.
4. The head in the right hand, a stick in the left, hold RMB — the tool is ready.

An iron tool is much faster than the chopper at its job; the chopper stays universal.
knowledge.genesis.primitive.farm.desc:
1. RMB the ground with a hoe — farmland.
2. Whatever you plant grows on it (a grass farm is a steady source of fiber).
knowledge.genesis.stone.smelt_copper.des: Smelting copper ore in the furnace. Copper is needed for wire in the steam age.
knowledge.genesis.stone.smelt_tin.desc: Smelting tin ore in the furnace. Tin is for solder.
knowledge.genesis.iron.plate.desc: The iron anvil is made on the workbench from ingots. Plates are forged on it (forging minigame).
knowledge.genesis.iron.rod.desc: Rods are drawn from an ingot on the iron anvil.
knowledge.genesis.iron.gear.desc: A gear is forged on the anvil from two plates.
knowledge.genesis.iron.boiler.desc: Plates and rods unlock the steam boiler design.
knowledge.genesis.iron.milestone.desc: Place a steam boiler — the primitive epoch is over, the industrial epoch (steam age) begins.
